mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName, COALESCE(MAX(c.name), '미배정 반') AS className, COALESCE(MAX(c.target_grade), '중2') AS schoolGrade, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ea.total_score), 1), 0.0) AS recentAverageScore, 96.0 AS attendanceRate FROM users u LEFT JOIN class_students cs ON u.user_id = cs.student_id AND cs.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN classes c ON cs.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN exam_attempts ea ON u.user_id = ea.student_id WHERE u.user_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name LIMIT 1

SELECT e.exam_id AS examId, e.title AS examTitle, COALESCE(e.exam_round, 1) AS examRound, ea.total_score AS studentScore, ea.max_score AS maxScore, ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(ea_all.total_score), 1) FROM exam_attempts ea_all WHERE ea_all.exam_id = e.exam_id ) AS classAverageScore, DATE_FORMAT(e.exam_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS examDate FROM exam_attempts ea JOIN exams e ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY e.exam_date ASC, e.exam_id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(eq.question_type, 'VOCAB') AS tag, -- 해당 영역(유형)의 총 만점 중 학생이 획득한 점수의 비율 (%) 계산 ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN eans.is_correct = 1 THEN eq.score ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(eq.score), 0), 1 ) AS studentScoreRate, -- 비교를 위한 전체 평균 비율 ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN eans.is_correct = 1 THEN eq.score ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(eq.score), 0), 1 ) AS classAvgScoreRate FROM exam_answers eans JOIN exam_questions eq ON eans.question_id = eq.question_id JOIN exam_attempts ea ON eans.attempt_id = ea.attempt_id WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY COALESCE(eq.question_type, 'VOCAB')

SELECT e.title AS examTitle, COALESCE(eq.question_type, '일반') AS largeCategory, COALESCE(eq.question_type_tag, '기본') AS smallCategory, ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN eans.is_correct = 1 THEN eq.score ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(eq.score), 0), 1 ) AS studentScoreRate FROM exam_answers eans JOIN exam_questions eq ON eans.question_id = eq.question_id JOIN exam_attempts ea ON eans.attempt_id = ea.attempt_id JOIN exams e ON ea.exam_id = e.exam_id WHERE ea.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY e.title, COALESCE(eq.question_type, '일반'), COALESCE(eq.question_type_tag, '기본')
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(question_type, 'VOCAB') AS largeCategory, COALESCE(question_type_tag, '기본') AS smallCategory FROM exam_questions WHERE question_type_tag IS NOT NULL
